execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."block" (
  "blockedUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "blockerId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."connection" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId1" text NOT NULL,
  "userId2" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastMingleAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId1" text NOT NULL,
  "userId2" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."heartBucket" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "targetUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "viewed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."like" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "toUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "viewed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mingle" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "conversationId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "deletedFor" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "forwarded" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "reactions" json,
  "readAt" timestamptz,
  "replyToId" text,
  "senderId" text NOT NULL,
  "viewOnce" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "mingle_deletedFor_elem_not_null_864b4a02" CHECK (array_position("deletedFor", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "href" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."package" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "chatLimit" int4,
  "durationDays" int4 NOT NULL,
  "features" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "incomingWinglesUnlocked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" float8 NOT NULL,
  "priorityVisibility" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "tagline" text NOT NULL,
  "wingleLimit" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pass" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "targetUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "viewed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment" (
  "amount" float8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "packageId" text NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."photo" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPrimary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "moderation" text DEFAULT 'approved' NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "uploadedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prompt" (
  "answer" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "question" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."report" (
  "context" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "detail" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "reporterId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "targetUserId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscription" (
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "packageId" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usage" (
  "chatUsed" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "winglesUsed" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "age" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "anonymousName" text,
  "bio" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "gender" text DEFAULT 'woman' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "intention" text DEFAULT 'Long-term relationship' NOT NULL,
  "interests" text NOT NULL,
  "isAnonymous" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastActiveAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "lifestyle" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "onboarded" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "online" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'member' NOT NULL,
  "suspended" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "traits" text NOT NULL,
  "verified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userStatus" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "photoUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wingle" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "note" text NOT NULL,
  "respondedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "toUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "viewed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
